anonymous_account.title: Explore LitList without commitments!
anonymous_account.description:
As a guest, you'll have access to our incredible features to discover and organize your favorite books.

However, you will have some limitations:

  • Want to Read Library: maximum 10 books
  • Currently Reading Library: maximum 10 books
  • Read Books Library: maximum 10 books
  • Reading Lists: Create up to 3 reading lists, each with space for 5 books.

Please note that as a guest account, your data may be deleted at any time.

You always have the option to upgrade to a regular account by registering from the Profile page, allowing you to retain your data and access LitList without limitations.
